summary: Stellus Capital Investment filed an 8-K reporting entry into a new investment advisory agreement with Stellus Capital Management following shareholder approval. The new agreement was necessitated by a change of control of the advisor resulting from its acquisition by Ridgepost Capital, an NYSE-listed parent. Terms are identical to the prior agreement except for the date and term; base and incentive fees unchanged. The initial term is two years with annual renewal provisions. This corporate event is akin to a management/services change due to an ownership shift of the advisor. Watch for subsequent regulatory filings from Ridgepost Capital for further details.
